newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen steady.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen steady.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.07 down at 41.35 to the dollar in the kerb market on Monday amid high demand for the U.S. currency but may open steady on Tuesday, dealers said.
The dollar supply is likely to outpace its demand and keep the rupee stable on Tuesday, one dealer said.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on May 6, was 40.3300/40.5317 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 2.35 percent.
